summary: Immuron Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching an ASX announcement about completing an unmarketable parcel facility (buy-back) for shareholders holding 18,518 or fewer shares (valued under $500) as of the record date. Eligible shareholders could opt out or increase holdings by June 1, 2026; otherwise Henslow sold shares, and the company bought them back at A$0.032/share (5-day VWAP). The buy-back cancelled 3,805,528 shares for ~$121,777 total, reducing administrative costs. No premium, advisor, or structural complexity. This is a routine corporate housekeeping item, not a special situation.
